text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, Ines Fujin invites me to visit<n>the
amusement park where she<n>works part-time, so I
drop by to see<n>how she's doing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, kiddos, let's all give the hero of<n>the park,
Park Knight, a nice loud<n>welcome! On the count of
three—one,<n>two...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Park Kniiight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Okay, let's try that one more<n>time! Park
Kniiight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, give me a second, everyone!<n>I'll just go
check up on Park Knight's<n>battle status!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like something's going on<n>backstage...
Worried, I go over to<n>check the situation.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Th-the mascot actor suddenly got<n>sick?!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
He's currently cooped up in the<n>restroom with
stomachache... It<n>doesn't look like it'll last too long,
but<n>could you buy us some time until we<n>can sort
this out?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Buy some time? I dunno... The only<n>time I ever go
on stage is to do my<n>winning concert dance routine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And that's a totally different<n>livey-vibey from a
superhero show.<n>Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there! Is it true that Park<n>Knight is in
trouble?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ...Wait, Biko?! And how come<n>you're here
too, Trainer?! This<n>area's off-limits to guests!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, it is an emergency,<n>but—wait a sec, we
really need to<n>figure out the stage situation! Maybe
we should just tell everyone the truth<n>and—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's Park Knight's duty as the hero of<n>this
amusement park to bring joy to<n>the children, right?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then we mustn't let the children<n>down! They've
come all the way<n>here to cheer for Park Knight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Telling the truth would<n>only
disappoint the kids and their<n>parents.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I really don't want to make these<n>families sad on
their day out together.<n>I might not be a hero, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to put on an entertaining<n>performance for
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...But how? This isn't a winning<n>concert, so I'm not
sure how well my<n>dance would go down.
choice_data_list:
How about incorporating your dance number into
the hero show?
An Ines-style dance would be best.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A hero-style dance number... That<n>could be fun!
Biko, could you give me<n>a hand?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Listen, everyone! We've got a<n>situation! Park
Knight's in a real<n>crisis!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, it's all my fault... Park Knight got<n>captured by
the enemy leader to save<n>my life!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that, everyone? You<n>know what this
means, right? We<n>have to cheer for Park Knight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's all dance together! I'm sure the<n>power of
dance will help save Park<n>Knight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You've got this, Park Knight!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You're super tough, Park Knight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone, show me your<n>biggest smiles!
All your smiles will<n>boost Park Knight's power!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The hero show is a great success,<n>with Ines
Fujin's performance<n>perfectly covering for the
park<n>mascot's absence.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
An Ines-style dance... Yeah. I practice<n>all the time to
make my fans smile!<n>This should be a piece of
cake!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, watch this, you two! Ines is<n>taking the stage!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Attention, all guests. There has been<n>a slight
change of schedule today, but<n>please enjoy this
mini dance show!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, everyone! Park Knight will<n>be back in
action soon, but until then,<n>let's all sing and dance
together!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: One, two, three! One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...And then finish with a spin! Okay,<n>got that? Now
let's add some lyrics to<n>this dance!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: One, t-two, three, and turn... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! That's perfect! Okay, let's<n>all become
dancing superstars and<n>give Park Knight a big
surprise!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The hero show is a great success,<n>with Ines
Fujin's performance<n>perfectly covering for the
park<n>mascot's absence.
